leads.arxiv: 2606.27499 (arXiv API: v1 2026-06-25; title: DMV-Bench: Diagnosing Long-Horizon Multimodal Agents' Visual Memory with Incidental Cue Injection)

community_list_entries.name: DMV-Bench: Diagnosing Long-Horizon Multimodal Agents' Visual Memory with Incidental Cue Injection

phase1_classification.kind_reason: An interactive benchmark for incidental visual memory in multimodal agents. Agents run chains of multi-session e-commerce shopping sessions and are later asked to recall pre-rendered visual cues from products seen earlier. The paper also proposes DualMem.
